en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a valley with forested hills behind it. The foreground and middle ground show dense clusters of steep‑roofed houses and small apartment buildings, some with dormer windows and simple ornamentation typical of Central European architecture from the late 19th to early 20th century. A road winds up the hillside on the right toward several large villas or manor‑like houses standing alone on the slope. Trees and gardens are interspersed throughout the town. The lower part of the image contains a large blank white rectangle, likely where a caption or message would appear on a postcard. No printed text is visible on the photograph itself.
